The club brief a fifth time, unchanged. 9067 proved the occluders reach the running scene (317 nodes from res://mission.tscn) and walked at 0.1% of frames missing 60 fps on a COLD lap. This run tests LF 0.103.0's closure fix: the gate used to judge a package that did not exist yet -- 274 files landed after it, including a twice-rewritten mission.tscn, occluders.tscn and project.godot, which meant required_autoload_count and required_plugin_count could never be non-zero because the file they read was not written yet.
